title: reoccurring beach hotel
content: First time I've ever posted about this, but I'm so glad I found this page. I've always remembered my dreams, but recently I keep going back to the same places, or I dream something and it happens in real life (or the opposite, I see something in real life and it triggers flashbacks of old dreams that date back years or more). Not sure if use of psychedelics (starting in 2019) over the past few years has played into this or not. I tend to return to the same beach front style hotel. Sometimes it feels like a cruise ship day stop, other times I get there by airplane and stay on vacation. Sometimes I have a fancy apartment that is next to the hotel with pool access connecting both places. It also seems crazy. but I've had a shark attack in the water at the hotel in my dream that feels so real, sometimes I question if it happened in real life in the past. Depending on the dream, I am either directly on the beach, maybe dining in a restaurant inside or I can only see the hotel from afar, but it always seems to be the same island and property. It's fun to have a relatable forum to talk about this, as it typically sounds crazy to my friends that rarely remember their dreams at all.
